title: Chilly mornings, cool afternoons bring fall weather to the Palm Beaches and Treasure Coast

 West Palm Beach, Fla. (WPEC) — The coolest air of the season is settling over the Palm Beaches and Treasure Coast this weekend. 
 Saturday starts chilly, stays cool through the afternoon and brings another cold night before temperatures begin to rebound Sunday.
 A chilly start Saturday morning 
 Temperatures will dip into the 50s for many coastal communities, with some inland areas falling into the upper 40s.
 Morning lows are scattered about the 50s this morning. (WPEC) 
 There has been a 10-15 degree temperature drop this morning from morning lows on Friday. (WPEC) 
 A light breeze will make it feel colder, especially away from the coast, where wind chills could reach the low to mid-40s before sunrise.
 If you’re heading out early, grab a jacket or sweatshirt—especially if you’ll be inland or spending time outside for a while.
 The warm-up this morning won't begin until closer to 8 a.m. (WPEC) 
 Sunshine, but a cool Saturday afternoon 
 Skies will clear, but sunshine won’t make it feel like a typical November afternoon. 
 Highs will mostly reach the upper 60s, with temperatures nearing 70 along the southern coast. 
 Temperatures will be in the 60s for most of Saturday with mostly clear skies. (WPEC) 
 North winds may gust up to around 15 mph, giving the afternoon a real "Fall-feel".
 A few layers should work well: wear a light jacket in the morning, then take it off as the day warms.
 It will still be a good idea to have a long-sleeved shirt handy if you’ll be out in the breeze.
 Another chilly night ahead 
 Saturday evening will cool down quickly after sunset. 
 Grabbing some light layering or choosing pants for evening plans will be a wise choice as temperatures will get chilly again. (WPEC) 
 Overnight lows are forecast in the 50s, with inland spots potentially dipping into the upper 40s. 
 It will be another night to bring pets indoors and make sure anyone spending time outside has a warm layer.
 One more cool morning Sunday 
 Sunday morning will bring one more chilly start. 
 Inland temperatures may again reach the 40s, while coastal areas stay mainly in the 50s. 
 Overall, most morning lows should be a few degrees warmer on Sunday morning compared to Saturday.
 Sunday morning will have a chill to it once again, but temperatures will be a few degrees warmer than Saturday morning. (WPEC) 
 By afternoon, highs will climb back into the 70s as northeast winds bring in slightly warmer air.
 Keep the jacket close through Sunday morning, then enjoy a milder afternoon with highs in the mid to upper 70s.
 How long has it been since we've been this chilly? 
 This weekend’s cool weather may feel like a shock, but it is not expected to bring frost or freezing temperatures that could damage plants, or result in falling iguanas.
 The bigger story is how long it has been since it felt this cool. 
 West Palm Beach last dipped below 60 degrees on March 24th earlier this year, and that was also the last time the Treasure Coast saw temperatures in the low 50s—nearly 235 days ago. 
 This is the first time temperatures are getting below 60 degrees in West palm Beach in 235 days. (WPEC) 
 So, while this is not dangerous cold, it may feel like quite a change after months of warmer weather.
